description: Specimen suit for recovery of dowry articles or covered personal property and belongings.

name: Suit for Declaration Regarding Family Rights

legalBasis.text: Jurisdiction depends upon the specific family right claimed and the applicable entry in Part I of the Schedule; section 7 governs institution.

description: Specimen suit seeking declaration concerning a family-law right within Family Court jurisdiction.

name: Suit for Custody of Minor

legalBasis.text: Part I of the Schedule includes custody of children; section 25 makes the Family Court a District Court for purposes of the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890 and requires the procedure prescribed by that Act for matters specified in it.

references.text: Section 17 concerns matters to be considered in appointing or declaring a guardian; section 25 concerns the title of a guardian to custody of the ward.

description: Specimen proceeding concerning custody of a minor before the Family Court.

name: Application/Petition for Visitation Rights

legalBasis.text: Part I of the Schedule expressly includes visitation rights of parents to meet their children; section 25 applies the Guardians and Wards Act procedure to matters specified in that Act.

references.text: Section 12 provides for interlocutory orders concerning production of the minor and temporary custody and protection.

description: Specimen application concerning visitation or meeting rights relating to a minor.

name: Petition for Guardianship of Minor

legalBasis.text: Sections 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 and 17 govern the order as to guardianship, persons entitled to apply, jurisdiction, form of application, procedure on admission and matters to be considered by the Court.

references.text: Part I of the Schedule includes guardianship and section 25 provides that the Family Court shall be deemed to be a District Court for purposes of the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890.

description: Specimen petition for appointment or declaration of guardianship of a minor.

name: Application for Interim Maintenance

legalBasis.text: Section 17-A provides for an interim order for maintenance at any stage of proceedings in a suit for maintenance.

description: Specimen application seeking interim maintenance during a maintenance suit.

name: Application for Interim Custody of Minor

legalBasis.text: Section 12 empowers the Court to make an interlocutory order for production of the minor and temporary custody and protection of the person or property of the minor.

references.text: Section 25 requires the Family Court, in dealing with matters specified in the Guardians and Wards Act, to follow the procedure prescribed in that Act.

description: Specimen application seeking temporary custody or interim protection concerning a minor.

name: Application for Interim Visitation

legalBasis.text: Part I of the Schedule includes visitation rights of parents; section 25 applies the Guardians and Wards Act procedure where the matter falls within that Act.

description: Specimen application seeking interim visitation or meeting arrangements concerning a minor.

references.text: Section 25 applies the Guardians and Wards Act procedure to matters specified in that Act.

description: Specimen application seeking production of a minor before the competent Court.
